L30@P2: 1.0 INTRODUCTION
L31@P2: 1.1 Background
L32@P2: Welcome to the Nairobi City County Service Charter—a bold commitment to transparency,
L33@P2: accountability, and citizen empowerment for Africa’s leading urban center. This Charter is
L34@P2: both a promise and a performance contract between Nairobi County Government, its staff,
L35@P2: and the millions of residents, businesses, and visitors who rely on its diverse range of
L36@P2: services every day.
L37@P2: Developed through broad stakeholder engagement and rooted in the values of Kenya’s
L38@P2: Constitution, the Service Charter provides a clear, accessible roadmap for what you can
L39@P2: expect from every sector and department in the county—from health and wellness,
L40@P2: education, and business opportunities to infrastructure, licensing, community support,
L41@P2: green environment, and beyond.
L42@P2: What the Charter Delivers:
L43@P2: • Clarity: Defines every service provided, the requirements, costs, timelines, and
L44@P2: access points—so users always know their rights and expectations.
L45@P2: • Accountability: Sets measurable standards and key performance indicators (KPIs)
L46@P2: for each function, ensuring staff and managers are accountable to the public and to
L47@P2: each other.
L48@P2: • Transparency: Makes service processes, user fees, turnaround times, and
L49@P2: escalation channels visible, minimizing bureaucracy and space for malpractices.
L50@P2: • Equity and Inclusion: Addresses the needs of all users—including women, youth,
L51@P2: persons with disabilities, the elderly, and vulnerable groups—making access truly
L52@P2: public.
L53@P2: • Continuous Improvement: Outlines built-in monitoring, evaluation, and feedback
L54@P2: mechanisms, with “You Said, We Did” commitments shaping service upgrades and
L55@P2: resource allocation.
L56@P2: A tool for all:
L57@P2: • For citizens: A guide to navigate and demand quality public services, lodge
L58@P2: enquiries or complaints, and participate in county affairs.
L59@P2: • For county staff: A reference for delivering effective, ethical, and efficient services
L60@P2-3: at the front line and in administrative planning.2 | P a g e
L61@P3: • For partners and stakeholders: A transparent window into Nairobi’s service
L62@P3-4: standards, collaboration opportunities, and mutual accountability.3 | P a g e
